import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder, StandardScaler
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths configuration
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")
SUBMISSION_FILE = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_template = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH)

# All feature columns (excluding id and target)
exclude_cols = {"id", "target"}
feature_cols = [c for c in train_df.columns if c not in exclude_cols]

X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df["target"]
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].copy()

# Convert numeric columns
for col in feature_cols:
    X_train[col] = pd.to_numeric(X_train[col], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
    X_test[col] = pd.to_numeric(X_test[col], errors="coerce").fillna(0)

# Encode categorical columns
X_train_enc = X_train.copy()
X_test_enc = X_test.copy()

if "f_27" in feature_cols:
    # Use one-hot encoding for high cardinality categorical feature
    ohe_colname = f"f_27_{len(pd.unique(train_df['f_27']))}_encoded"
    ohe = OneHotEncoder(
        handle_unknown="use_encoded_value", unknown_value=-1, output_type="sparse"
    )
    enc_values = ohe.fit_transform(train_df[["f_27"]])
    test_enc_values = ohe.transform(test_df[["f_27"]])

    # Add encoded column to dataframe
    X_train_enc[ohe_colname] = ohe.codes_.flatten()
    X_test_enc[ohe_colname] = ohe.codes_.flatten()

# Convert all to float for modeling
X_train_final = X_train_enc.astype(np.float32)
X_test_final = X_test_enc.astype(np.float32)
y_train_full = y_train.astype(np.int32)

# Split into train/val for honest evaluation
X_tr, X_val_true, y_tr, y_val_true = train_test_split(
    X_train_final, y_train_full, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_full
)

print("Training model...")
model = lgb.train(
    {
        "objective": "binary",
        "metric": "auc",
        "boosting_type": "gbdt",
        "num_leaves": 64,
        "learning_rate": 0.05,
        "n_estimators": 2000,
        "random_state": 42,
        "verbose": -1,
        "min_child_samples": 20,
        "max_depth": 8,
        "subsample": 0.8,
        "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
        "lambda_l1": 0.0,
        "lambda_l2": 0.0,
        "seed": 42,
    },
    lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr),
    valid_sets=[
        lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr),
        lgb.Dataset(X_val_true, label=y_val_true),
    ],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=100, verbose=False)],
)

# Early stopping iteration
best_iter = model.best_iteration
pred_val_prob = model.predict(X_val_true, num_iteration=best_iter)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_true, pred_val_prob)
print(f"AUC-ROC Score: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Predictions on test set
pred_test_prob = model.predict(X_test_final, num_iteration=best_iter)

# Save submission file
sample_id = sample_template["id"].values
sample_target = sample_template["target"].values

submission_data = np.column_stack((sample_id, pred_test_prob))
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(submission_data, columns=["id", "target"])
submission_df.to_csv(SUBMISSION_FILE, index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully!")
